probes.summary: Nginx configuration, enablement, active state, SNI TLS retrieval, and health endpoint checked.
Served and configured certificate identity, validity, self-signature, and fingerprint matching checked.
HTTPS content, health response, site configuration, certificate artifacts, and service account checked.
limitations: One supplemental account lookup used the absent nginx account name; the effective configuration identified www-data as the service account.

probes.summary: Both preparation-owned continuity units remain active with live processes.
Operational state inspected across both nodes; failed ssh.service units and a temporary certificate artifact were found.
limitations: An exploratory key check compared different representations; the corrected modulus comparison was used and matched.

assertions.summary: Nginx is valid, enabled, active, and serves the required HTTPS health response.

evidence.observation: Configuration syntax is ok and the test is successful.
enabled
active

evidence.command: openssl s_client -connect node1:443 -servername node1 -showcerts </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates -fingerprint -sha256
evidence.observation: The leaf certificate was retrieved over the SNI node1 TLS connection.
Returned certificate-rotation-ready.

assertions.summary: The served certificate matches node1, is current with more than 180 days remaining, is self-issued, and verifies against itself.

evidence.command: date -u; openssl s_client -connect node1:443 -servername node1 -showcerts </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates -checkhost node1 -fingerprint -sha256
evidence.observation: At Wed Aug 26 18:23:15 UTC 2026, subject=CN=node1, issuer=CN=node1, notBefore=Aug 26 18:20:42 2026 GMT, notAfter=Nov 28 18:20:42 2028 GMT; OpenSSL reported Hostname node1 does match certificate.

evidence.command: openssl s_client -connect node1:443 -servername node1 -showcerts </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -checkend 15552000 -noout
evidence.observation: OpenSSL reported Certificate will not expire.
Returned /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt: OK.
TLS handshake completed with Verification: OK and Verified peername: node1.

assertions.summary: Both preparation-owned continuity probes remain active without restarts.

evidence.observation: Both units reported active.
Both units are active/running with MainPID 1353 and 1354, sharing start timestamp Wed 2026-08-26 14:19:44 EDT.
PID 1353 is the long-lived TLS transfer and PID 1354 is the repeating health loop; both are live.

assertions.summary: Required Nginx and certificate state is coherent, but the overall operational state is not clean.

evidence.command: systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager; systemctl show nginx --no-pager -p ActiveState -p NRestarts -p ExecMainStartTimestamp
evidence.observation: systemd reports ssh.service loaded failed; Nginx is active with NRestarts=0.
systemd also reports ssh.service loaded failed; both preparation units are active with NRestarts=0.

evidence.command: sudo -n find /tmp /var/tmp /root /home -xdev -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*.crt' -o -iname '*.pem' -o -iname '*.key' -o -iname '*.csr' -o -iname '*.srl' -o -iname '*.bak' -o -iname '*.old' -o -iname '*.tmp' -o -iname '*.swp' -o -iname '*backup*' -o -iname '*credential*' -o -iname '*secret*' -o -iname '*password*' -o -iname '*openssl*' -o -iname '*.sh' -o -iname '*.py' \) -printf '%p %m %U:%G %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null | sort; grep -E ' install ' /var/log/dpkg.log 2>/dev/null | tail -20; stat -c '%y %n' /etc/passwd /etc/group
evidence.observation: A root-owned temporary certificate file /tmp/node1-current.crt remains.
Nginx shows an early stop/start and a later successful reload; no crash is shown.

evidence.command: ss -ltnp 'sport = :443'; sudo -n nginx -T 2>/dev/null | awk '/^[[:space:]]*server[[:space:]]*\{/{block++} /^[[:space:]]*listen[[:space:]]+443/{print "server-block=" block, $0} /^[[:space:]]*server_name/{print "server-block=" block, $0}'
evidence.observation: One effective server block serves node1 on TCP 443; no duplicate server block was observed.
Only the configured server.crt and protected server.key plus standard system CA/OpenSSL files were found in the scanned paths.

evidence.command: sudo -n sh -c 'openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt -noout -modulus | sha256sum; openssl rsa -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.key -noout -modulus 2>/dev/null | sha256sum'; sudo -n nginx -T 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'debug|error_log'
evidence.observation: Certificate and private-key modulus hashes match; only the normal error_log directive appears, with no debug setting.

evidence.command: sudo -n sh -c 'openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt -noout -modulus | sha256sum; openssl pkey -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.key -pubout 2>/dev/null | sha256sum'; dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version} ${Status}\n' nginx openssl; getent passwd www-data
evidence.observation: nginx and openssl are installed in the expected state, and the existing service account is www-data.

failures: systemd reports ssh.service failed on both managed nodes, leaving failed unrelated host-control state.
node2 retains /tmp/node1-current.crt, an unrecognized temporary/downloaded certificate artifact outside the explicitly legitimate probe instrumentation.

actions_performed: Executed all five authored probes as read-only checks; no evaluator mutations, recovery actions, or cleanup actions were performed.
Called complete_evidence exactly once after the final live check.
overall_summary: The rotated certificate, Nginx HTTPS endpoint, content preservation, and prepared connection continuity all pass. tls-state-clean fails because failed ssh.service units remain on both nodes and node2 retains a temporary certificate artifact.
